result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, conditional cyber coverage at USD 5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It leaves the original provision unchanged and is generally professionally drafted. However, requiring every policy to remain in place for one year after the Term exceeds the playbook and is not necessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. The added covenant would also be cleaner as a separately numbered insurance subsection.
